high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post from the user "abhiandnow." The post was made one day ago and includes a photo of a person holding a book titled "Project Hail Mary" by Andy Weir. The book cover features a futuristic design with a face illuminated by colorful lights. The text overlay on the image reads: "I’m crying, I’m laughing, I’m mindblown. I’ve only read half of it, but it is already my favourite piece of literature in last 5-6 years." In the background, there is a kitchen setting with various items such as a sink
